title: This Week’s MSFS Airport Releases Are AMAZING! | New Add‑Ons for PC Players
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update for [February 14, 2026] brings a massive MSFS 2020 update featuring 9 NEW MSFS airports and essential MSFS scenery updates for PC players. If you are looking for the latest flight simulator addons, this MSFS PC Marketplace drop is one of the biggest yet, featuring highly detailed new airports and Dreamscenery lights enhancements.

Whether you are flying into EDXE Rheine Eschendorf, exploring FMEE Reunion Roland Garros, or landing at GMMX Menara Airport, these flight sim news highlights cover everything you need for your next sortie.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 SPINOZA: EDXE Rheine Eschendorf (German airfield with light GA focus)
🛫 FSDG: FMEE Reunion Roland Garros International Airport (Beautiful volcanic island destination)
🛫 IsmaBerk: GMMX Menara Airport (Scenic Moroccan hub near the Atlas Mountains)
🛫 FSDG: GVAC Cabo Verde Sal (Perfect for long‑haul island operations)
🛫 FSDG: HKMO Moi International Airport Mombasa (Major East African coastal airport)
🛫 SPINOZA: KHWO North Perry Hollywood Airport (Busy South Florida GA hotspot)
🛫 France VFR: LFKB Bastia Poretta Airport (Corsican holiday gateway)
🛫 FSX3D: LFKJ Ajaccio Napoléon Bonaparte (Another stunning Corsican coastal airport)
🛫 Project MAX: WAMM Sam Ratulangi Intl Airport Manado (Indonesian regional hub in Sulawesi)
